resources.string: Hides suggested stories, reels, threads (Suggested posts will still be shown).

Long-press the Home tab to open developer options. If a menu appears, choose Developer options.
Long-press the Home tab to open MetaConfig overrides directly. If a menu appears, choose Developer options.

Domain to use when sharing links
Underlines plain http, https and www. addresses in feed captions. Tapping one opens it in your external browser, without trackers when Sanitize share links is on
Long-pressing the Send button under a post in the home feed copies the post link, cleaned like Copy link. A tap still opens the share sheet

The eye button also marks that person\'s earlier stories as seen

Liking a story moves on to the next story
Sending a reply or quick reaction moves on to the next story
Mark a chat as read after you send a reply, even when viewing direct messages anonymously or using all ghost modes
While viewing direct messages anonymously, the other person sees that you read the chat once you do one of these in it. Start typing only works while typing status is shown
When enabled, others can\'t see when you\'ve read their messages. When both this setting and Turn on all ghost modes are disabled, Instagram\'s Show read receipts setting is used

Choose a chat with Choose for ghost mode in the menu you get by holding it in your inbox. Tap a chat here to remove it. Each account has its own chosen chats. Only read receipts follow this list, typing status does not
Chat removed from chosen ghost chats

Instagram sees the saved place you choose instead of where your device is, in posts, stories, Notes, the Friends Map and nearby search, and its background location and Wi-Fi collection is skipped. Instagram may notice a location that doesn\'t match your network, and this can put your account at risk. Locations saved inside photos and videos are not changed
No place chosen yet. While Fake location is on, Instagram sees a random point in the Mojave Desert until you choose one
Chosen: %1$s (%2$s). Places are kept on this device for every account
No saved places yet. Add one with its coordinates or a maps link
Coordinates or a maps link. Left empty: %1$s (Mojave Desert)
No coordinates found. Latitude goes from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180. Short maps links can\'t be read, so open the link and copy the full one

Shows Instagram\'s own options to hide your followers and following lists and to hide you from other people\'s lists in Settings, Account privacy. Instagram offers them only to some teen accounts in the UK, and the server decides whether a change is kept. Using options the server did not offer your account can put it at risk
Turns on the ghost modes available in this build
Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.
Hides posts from the home feed
Removes the Reels tab from the navigation bar. Reels shared with you still open.
Off. Pick what to lock and for how long, then lock it.
Locked until %1$s. Unlocking early requires a 24 hour cooling-off period.
Unlock available at %1$s (lock expires %2$s). Tap to cancel the request.
Cooling-off period is over. Tap to unlock.
Pick at least one setting to lock first.
The settings you picked stay on for %1$s. To unlock early you have to request it and wait up to %2$d hours. Resetting and importing settings are blocked while locked. The app will restart.
The lock stays active for another %1$d hours. After that, come back here and confirm the unlock.
This ends Focus Lock. The app will restart.
Not available while Focus Lock is active.

Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the \'Tip\' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
Prevents opening the creation screen by swiping right on the home tab.
Hide stories tray from main feed
Hides the hidden requests (spam) button in the message requests page
Hides notes tray in DM section
Hide group creation button on sharesheet
Removes the follow button from the Reels author row
Disable double tap like on post
Disable double tap like on reel
Disable double tap like on comment

Removes the visual search button from the Reels side buttons
Hides the note bubble on profile pictures, including the add note bubble on your own profile
Removes the Threads button from the profile header
Turns off Instagram\'s Friends Map, including its entry in the inbox notes tray. Stop sharing your location in the map before you turn this on
Removes your recent searches from the search screen and from the suggestions while you type
Uses Instagram\'s older, mostly square Explore layout instead of the tall 3:4 grid. Some sections can still be tall, tablets keep the tall grid, and the topic pills above it can go away
Removes the comment bar at the bottom of the Reels viewer
Removes the title bar at the top of the Reels tab. Reels opened from anywhere else keep theirs, with the back button
Turns off Blend, which removes its button from chat headers. Blends you already have can no longer be opened
Removes the Instants stack from the inbox. Instants themselves keep working
Adds a follows you back status label on the profile page and shows a detailed friendship status breakdown on click
Adds a badge to rows in your own Following list for accounts that don\'t follow you back
Scan finished: %1$s followers and %2$s following received
Scan stopped because Instagram did not send the lists. Try again later.
No scan yet. Start a scan to see who doesn\'t follow you back.
Clear the change history of this account? Its scans are kept.
Delete all scans, the change history and the visited profiles of this account? This can\'t be undone.
Everyone you follow follows you back.
You follow back all your followers.
No one you follow follows you back yet.
No changes yet. Changes show up here after your next scan.
No visited profiles yet. Profiles you open show up here.
Keeps a list of the profiles you open on this device, per account, newest 500, in the Profile analyzer.
This also shows when the account was deactivated, blocked you or was removed by you.
Couldn\'t read the analyzer data. Try again.
Shows the full number of posts, followers and following on profiles, such as 12,345 instead of 12.3K
Shows posts on profile grids as square thumbnails instead of tall 3:4 ones
Stops the vibrations Instagram plays on taps, long presses and swipes. Your phone\'s settings are not changed
Adds a Saved tab after the other tabs on your own profile. Restart the app to apply.
Asks before you like a post or Reel with the heart button. Unliking is not asked.
Asks before you follow an account with a Follow button
Asks before you repost a post in the feed or a Reel in the Reels tab. Undoing a repost is not asked.
Asks before a comment you typed is posted. Comments with only a GIF or photo are not asked.
Confirm comments in the comment box
Confirm comments in the comment sheet
Asks before a Following or Requested button unfollows a public account or withdraws your follow request. Instagram already asks before you unfollow a private account.
Asks before you like a story with the heart or send a quick reaction from the reply bar. Unliking is not asked.
Asks before the audio or video call button at the top of a chat starts a call
Asks before you accept a follow request in Activity or the follow requests list
Nothing was done: it changed while you were deciding. Try again.
Asks before pulling down reloads Home, Reels or your inbox. Cancel stops the spinner and keeps what is shown. Pressing back at the top of Reels also asks, since it refreshes the same way.
Asks before you like a comment. Unliking is not asked.
Asks before swiping up in a chat turns disappearing messages on or off
Turn disappearing messages on or off for this chat?
Don\'t refresh Home on tab tap
Tapping Home again still scrolls to the top but no longer loads new posts
Don\'t refresh Home in the background
Stops Home from loading new posts while the app is in the background. Home may still reload when you open the app after a long time.
Don\'t refresh Reels on tab tap
Tapping Reels again still goes back to the top but no longer loads new Reels
Continue a Reel from where you left off when you scroll back to it
In the feed, hold the left or right edge of a playing video to watch it at 2x. In Reels, a Speed row appears in the More menu and in the menu that opens when you long-press a Reel.
Reels and feed videos start at this speed, with normal voice pitch. A speed picked in Speed and seek applies to that Reel only.
Reels play without sound until you turn sound on. After that, sound stays on the way Instagram normally keeps it.
A Reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch it again from the start.
Tap a Reel to pause or play it instead of turning its sound on or off. Double-tap to like and long-press work as before.
A video you open full screen from the home feed starts without sound. Instagram shares one sound setting between the feed and Reels, so the feed stays muted afterwards until you turn sound back on.

On adds Instagram\'s Auto scroll switch to the Reels menu even if Instagram has not turned it on for your account; Reels then move on by themselves once you switch it on there. Off removes it. Default leaves it to Instagram.

When you leave Instagram, for example with the home gesture, while a Reel or a full-screen feed video plays, it keeps playing in a small window; expand the window to go back. Uses Instagram\'s own picture-in-picture for Reels; it only works if picture-in-picture is allowed for Instagram in Android settings.
Play this video first, then try again
Fetches max resolution images from server. May reduce performance, increase app data size, or cause the app to switch to an older layout
Adds buttons to copy comments and their authors’ usernames on posts and reels
Hides your inbox behind your fingerprint, face or screen lock every time you open the app
While Inbox lock is up, message notifications hide the sender and content, and the in-app message banner stays hidden
Set a screen lock on your device to use Inbox lock
Adds a hide option to the chat long-press menu that moves the chat to a private inbox, separate for each account.
Don\'t show notifications for messages from chats you have hidden

Adds Pin to the menu you get by holding a chat in your inbox. Pinned chats move to the top of the share sheet before you type, and the people of pinned one-to-one chats to the top of your recent searches, when Instagram lists them. One Instagram listed there stays on top for 30 minutes after it last did, even when Instagram leaves it out, like after clearing recents; a hidden chat is not brought back while your hidden chats are closed. Each account has its own pins.
Pin in share sheet and search
Unpin from share sheet and search
Tap the messages button this many times in a row to switch between your inbox and your hidden chats
Prevents swiping up in a chat from enabling disappearing messages
Sends GIFs picked in the keyboard\'s GIF picker as animated images, instead of showing \"Tap the sticker icon to find and send GIFs\"
Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view
Mark view-once messages as seen by hand

While Make ephemeral media permanent is on, adds an eye button next to the reply box of photos and videos you open in a chat. Tapping it tells the sender you saw the one on screen; with Don\'t auto-advance view-once messages on, it then goes to the next one. View direct messages anonymously does not hide these receipts. Kept receipts last until the app is closed
Photos and videos you open in a chat stay on screen after their time runs out. Tap to go to the next one or to close the viewer.
For the people you chose, only while Instagram is running. A change within 2 minutes of that person\'s previous one is not reported
For the people you chose, only while Instagram is running and Instagram updates their active status. A change within 2 minutes of that person\'s previous one is not reported
Notify when they type to you
In your chat with a person you chose, only while Instagram is running. At most once every 2 minutes per person
Notify when they read your message
In your chat with a person you chose, only while Instagram is running. At most once every 2 minutes per person

Choose a person with Notify me about activity in the menu you get by holding your chat with them in your inbox. Tap a person here to remove them. Each account has its own list. Nothing is sent to Instagram, and there is no notification while Instagram is closed
You\'ll get activity notifications for this chat while Instagram is running
Tells you when people you chose come online, go offline, type to you or read your message

How often Instagram checks who is active, only while the app is open. Faster refreshes send extra requests to Instagram and can put your account at risk. Default keeps Instagram\'s own timing; Instagram may not use this refresh when it gets active status in real time
The chat header shows the time the person was last active instead of \"Active 5m ago\" when Instagram has it. \"Active now\" stays
Show how ephemeral media was received
Adds a line under photos and videos that were sent as ephemeral media saying how they were sent and until when they are available
Enable mark chat as read option
Get an option, on long pressing the chat, to mark it as read. When you mark a chat as read, others can see that you\'ve read their messages, even when View direct messages anonymously is enabled
Customise the timestamp that shows when the story was posted
Change the size of story ring by a percentage (Default: 100)
Disable automatic flipping/moving to next story
Replay the current story when it ends
Stories play without sound until you turn sound on in the story viewer, for example with the volume buttons. Reels and feed videos are not muted by this.
Speed and seek works on video stories only
Hides the follow button at the top of stories from accounts you do not follow

People whose stories are saved when Auto-save stories is set to Listed users. Add or remove someone with Add to or remove from auto-save list in the ⋯ menu of their story, or tap a name here to remove it

Hold the settings button on the viewer list of your own story to search its viewers by username or name, and to show only Followers, Not following you back or Starred. The follow filters use your last Profile analyzer scan. Load all viewers there asks Instagram for every remaining page of viewers: each page is one extra request that Instagram can see, and a long list takes many

Only the viewers Instagram has loaded are searched. Load all viewers to search the rest
Instagram sent no more viewers for now. Try Load all viewers again later
Reading your last Profile analyzer scan…
Followers and Not following you back need the Profile analyzer patch, so they find nobody

Followers and Not following you back use your Profile analyzer scan of %1$s
Followers and Not following you back use your Profile analyzer scan of %1$s, %2$s days ago, so they may be out of date
Tap a viewer to open their profile. Hold a viewer to star or unstar them

Tap the download button on posts, reels, or stories to save the current media. If there are multiple media, hold the button to save them all
Downloads videos as the sharpest DASH rendition Instagram lists, up to 1080p AV1, instead of the 720p H.264 file
Re-encodes the xHE-AAC sound of DASH downloads as AAC-LC at 192 kbps, which every player can play

On lets you swipe left and right to move between the main tabs, using Instagram\'s own swipeable tabs. Off turns that swiping off. Default leaves it to Instagram.
Shows the tabs in a rounded bar that floats over your feed, with a highlight behind the selected tab. On Android 15 and later, the feed also shows below the bar, down to the bottom of the screen.
The tab bar slides away while you scroll down your feed and comes back when you scroll up or reach the top

Makes the floating tab bar look like frosted glass, with a light edge and a soft shadow. On Android 12 and later, your feed shows blurred through the bar; on older versions the bar is a nearly solid tint. The blur can make scrolling less smooth on slower phones.
This setup removes every spookd settings entry from the visible tabs. You can still open spookd settings by long-pressing the app icon and selecting spookd settings.

Turns spookd features off on this device without changing your settings, so turning this off brings them all back. Inbox lock, hidden chats, Focus Lock and these settings keep working. Changes made when patching stay.

Capture view-once Instants as you view them, so you can re-view and download them later from “View saved Instants”.
No saved Instants yet. Open some Instants with capture enabled and they\'ll appear here.

Instagram is not told you opened an Instant, so it stays unseen for its sender. Senders on the Always mark seen list are still told. An Instant whose sender can\'t be identified is not marked seen. Turn on all ghost modes turns this on too.
Senders whose Instants are marked seen even while Don\'t mark Instants seen is on
Senders whose Instants are never marked seen. While this list has anyone, an Instant whose sender can\'t be identified is not marked seen either.
No senders yet. Open some Instants and their senders show up here to pick.
Instants you capture are discarded when they would be sent. The Instants camera still opens.
Instants creation is off, so this Instant was not sent
Asks before a recorded Instant video is sent. Leaving the camera before or while asked discards the video.
Asks before an emoji reaction to an Instant is sent

Captures incoming DMs locally as they arrive from the server. Marks messages as deleted when unsent, so you can view them even after the sender deletes them. Also lists reactions that others remove from saved messages, when the updated message arrives in real time.
No deleted messages captured yet.\nEnable the feature and messages will be saved as they arrive.
No unsent messages or removed reactions to delete.
Couldn\'t delete the log. Try again.
Delete all %d unsent messages and removed reactions in the log, including the ones not shown yet? Saved view-once media of messages that were not unsent stays.
Notifies when a received message is unsent
Profile pictures can\'t be refreshed right now

Downloads every received DM photo, video and voice message as it arrives, on any network, so it uses mobile data and up to 8 GB of storage. Media of messages that are not unsent is removed after 30 days, except view-once media, which stays until you delete it. After you turn this setting off, nothing new is saved, and once Instagram restarts the cleanup stops too. Saved media opens from View deleted messages after you confirm your screen lock, on Android 11 or newer.

Saves view-once and view-twice photos, videos and voice messages as they arrive, without opening them, so the sender is not told. They stay until you delete them and count toward the 8 GB; when they fill it, nothing new is saved. When off, view-once media is not saved, and camera photos and videos may be skipped while Make ephemeral media permanent is on.
This saved media can\'t be read
Finish unlocking, then tap the item again
Saved media opens only after you confirm your screen lock. This needs Android 11 or newer with a screen lock set.
